title: Three Easy Ways to Send Accounts
status: rendered to Production Handoff standards (proof-of-concept tier)
objective: Encourage the first account placement from signed-but-inactive clients.
activation_barrier: 'I don't know HOW to get my accounts to SWRS.'
core_message: Getting your accounts to SWRS is easier than you think.

engine_mapping.fix: three easy channels: email / portal / Excel

distribution: Day-30 slot of the activation drip; auto-stops on first placement.

production.style: polished modern 3D animated commercial, cohesive cool-blue SWRS palette
production.logo_animation: official white SWRS logo (media 38707f0b) fades in top-center on the BRAND-CLOSE CARD ONLY (t=18.2s, 0.8s alpha fade, 520px, soft drop shadow). Standard: logo only in the last scene.
production.audio_mix: standard DUCKING mix: scene SFX full except during VO windows (hook 0.3-3.65s, enumeration+main 5.1-19.45s -> 0.22x); VO 1.25-1.3x; amix normalize=0 + alimiter 0.95.

hook_voiceover.line: THREE easy ways to send us your accounts?!
hook_voiceover.placement: t=0.4s over scene 1 (Victor buried in invoices), lower-third caption. Replaced longer first take 4334f094 (7.0s, would have collided with the enumeration line).

hook_voiceover.line: One: email. Two: the portal. Three: an Excel file.
hook_voiceover.placement: t=5.2s over scene 2 (three glowing icons), lower-third caption '1 Email  2 Portal  3 Excel'

voiceover.line: Pick whichever is easiest — we'll take care of the rest. Just email info@swrecovery.com.
voiceover.spoken_as: email read as 'info at S-W Recovery dot com'
voiceover.placement: t=10.6s under scene 3 (8.55s). Replaced longer first take 30becda3 (17.2s, would not fit the 23s cut); the tagline is carried by the brand card instead.

outputs._note: 23s, three-part Arthur VO, ducking mix, logo on brand card only (chain verified in-frame during build: absent at 14/17s, present at 20/22s).
